audit.platform: WordPress / WooCommerce (openresty; blocks automated tools with 403)
audit.concept_type: webshop: department catalogue with filters, product pages, a quote-list cart drawer, checkout preview handing off to their store or emailing the quote
must_keep: departments with counts (Disposables 176, Gift Wrap 200, Eco-Friendly 89, Cleaning & Janitorial, Office & School, Hotel Restaurant & Bar, Candy & Gum, Warehouse & Shipping)
product pages, many priced 'contact us for a quote'
weaknesses: site refuses automated previews and link tools (403)
most products have no price, only 'contact us for a quote'
hours and address only in directories
printing lives on a separate Facebook page
audit.note: Large WooCommerce catalogue (hundreds of SKUs, many quote-only); site blocks Firecrawl even with stealth proxy, so product data is limited to search snippets. Build after A and B.
